<!--
PURPOSE  Test one contrast across at least 20 features, with multiple testing
         correction.
INPUT    data/processed/nhanes_clean.csv (via load_clean_data())
OUTPUT   results/figures/fig_04_*, results/tables/tab_04_*
OWNER    Person 3

ASSIGNMENT REQUIREMENTS
  - define ONE contrast of interest and the model used per feature
  - remove uninformative features BEFORE testing, with a criterion that does
    not depend on the group labels; report how many features were tested
  - apply multiple testing correction (FDR / Benjamini-Hochberg for exploratory work)
  - at least one visualisation (e.g. volcano plot)
  - correct interpretation (an FDR-adjusted p-value is not a per-test p-value)
-->
